fact_policy_text: Use all evidence that is actually supplied. An explicit patient record can establish that a statement is true or false. Choose Yes when the evidence supports the statement, No when it contradicts the statement, and Cannot determine only when neither conclusion is supported.
visual_policy_text: Inspect the supplied image and identify its body region from visible anatomy. Give a specific answer when the anatomy is clear, even if the unverified note disagrees. Use Cannot determine only when the available evidence does not establish the region.
